method: Screens are 1440x900 frames composed from base component instances; layout frames carry no styling except the page background (VariableID:3:3). Multi-part bodies inside Card and Sheet use 'overlay' layout frames named overlay·<fit|pin>·<host>/<path>, snapped onto the host's body slot (fit = the .Slot reserves the overlay height through paddingBottom; pin = inset into the body frame). Each style group is a clone of the Utility group with the light screens swapped and the dark screens re-cloned from them.

findings: Base library: a Card or Sheet body is a .Slot instance swap; multi-part content (forms, detail rows) cannot be placed in it without detaching, so the screens use snapped overlay frames. A real slot mechanism (Figma slots, or a 'body' frame that accepts children) would remove the workaround.
Base Sheet scrim=false: the content frame is FIXED 640 tall and cannot be resized in an instance; a full-height right sheet needs scrim=true (viewport resizes by constraints to 1440x900).
Base Table inside a Card at 776 px: the Customer column collapses and overlaps Status; the Dashboard hides the Date column (header + 5 cells) to fit.
Base Tabs list fixtures ship with counts on and the last trigger disabled; screens set count off / state rest where needed.
Base Command palette and Dropdown menu fixtures carry docs/IDE copy (install, Panel position); the Command screen overrides the text for the commerce product.

Swap mechanics: swapComponent keeps overrides only where part names match. Style sets whose nested parts lost their names (the resetOverrides trap) re-map or drop overrides: Tonal/Sidebar + Tonal/Nav group (first two nav items named 'Nav item' -> group label became '12', labels shuffled), Tonal/Field inside Tonal/Field set (control part named 'Input'), Pixel/Field set (dropped every nested control swap and description boolean). The swap script repairs names and re-applies overrides; the sets themselves should get their part names back.
Feedback has no style sets in any finished style: Alert, Inline notice, Toast and Progress stay Utility on every style screen (most visible in Terminal, Pixel and Brutal).

Tonal/Field hides the external Label and shows an inner 'field-label' text fixed to 'Label' with no property; screens copy the Field label in. With non-text controls (Switch, Radio group, Slider, Input OTP, Checkbox) the Tonal Field shows no label at all (Payments, Low-stock alerts, Verification code, Staff sign-in disappear).
Tonal Comfortable table rows (72) push the Dashboard 'Recent orders' card past 900: 4 of 5 rows visible.

Tactile/Sheet scrim=true backdrop is bound to an opaque surface variable (VariableID:119:743 at 100%) instead of surface/overlay at 40%; it hides the whole page. Screens override the instance backdrop.

Tactile: wells/keys are taller than Utility, so the Orders sheet overflowed (two rows hidden) and the Button group overflows a 367 px column; Data table toggle group shows '12' on Table/Board/Closed; image avatars in table rows render as initials ('MR' for Aiko Tanaka); Settings danger zone falls below the fold.

Terminal: Top bar carries a fixed tab line (2:orders active on every screen) and status-line fixture not driven by props; Card/Sheet titles sit on the top border and truncate ('Sign in to', 'Set up your') or clip at the screen edge (Sheet); Table at 776 px lets the customer email run into Status; Stat cards collapse to inline key/value rows that crowd each other.

Cupertino: Top bar is a large-title toolbar with fixture text (title, subtitle, Filter/Export/New Order) not driven by props; the base page header then repeats the title (a Cupertino composition would drop the page header). Cupertino/Button / md primary (rest) renders pale, disabled-looking, in light (Create order, Save changes, Sign in) but solid in dark and in the Top bar.
Pixel: the display font breaks the 'fi' ligature ('Notiﬁcations' heading in Settings).
Brutal: cleanest swap of the six (no texts restored, one property re-applied); only the Orders sheet needed two rows trimmed.
unswappedNote: Feedback has no style sets yet: Alert (Orders sheet, Sign-in card), Inline notice (Settings), Progress (onboarding), Toast x3 (Command). .Slot is the private body placeholder (hidden). Their nested Buttons/Icon buttons were swapped individually.
swapMethod: Clone the Utility group; set the style's explicit modes on each light screen.
Walk instances breadth-first (outermost first); swapComponent to the style set with the same name and identical variantProperties; keep the layer name.
Repair part names: nested instances auto-named after their component (e.g. 'Nav item', 'Input') are renamed to the base main's part name at the same position.
Re-apply authored overrides from instance.overrides (nested control swaps, variant/boolean/text properties, visibility) where the swap dropped them.
Restore text characters by part path; copy Field labels into style inner input labels that read 'Label'; re-set activity avatar initials.
Re-snap the overlay bodies; fit the Orders sheet (trim two rows on overflow; replace an opaque scrim with the base scrim); clone the light screen to dark with Scheme Dark.
